messages:
Emily Park: Ok folks, new ask from Acme: they want minute-level billing with SLA-aligned lookback for 7 days. We need a governance playbook before we sign off.
Carlos Gomez: Partner ops here. We can emit minutely events or 5m batched payloads. Main constraint: some devices go offline and replay later.
Omar Ruiz: Replays are the trickiest part. We must agree on replay semantics: replay_id + event_time. We'll dedupe by (device_id, event_time, replay_id).
Liam Chen: Also define acceptable late-arrival window. I propose 72h for usage ingestion, with 24h for guaranteed same-day billing. Anything later triggers adjustment bucket.
Sophie Patel: Legal asked about credits if partner submits late data that changes billed units. Do we offer retro-credits?
Emily Park: Policy suggestion: we allow adjustments within 30 days; the partner must submit an adjustment record flagged as "adjustment" with original_event_ref. Finance to approve credits > $500.
Carlos Gomez: Fine. We'll include an "adjustment" boolean and original_event_id in replay payloads.
Omar Ruiz: Tech checklist (initial): 1) webhook contract v1 agreed 2) HMAC signature verification 3) timezone normalization (partners can send tz) 4) idempotency strategy 5) replay acceptance 6) backfill rate limits 7) SLAs/alerts
Liam Chen: For alerts: ingest_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 10m => page SRE; avg_event_latency > 90s for 10m => page ingestion owner; replay_duplicate_ratio > 2% for 30m => investigate.
Sophie Patel: Operational notes: partner will produce a daily entitlement CSV at UTC 00:00; we will reconcile entitlements with usage to detect seat mismatches.
Emily Park: Reconciliation cadence: daily automated run + weekly manual spot checks for first month. We'll provide an exceptions report to partner ops.
Carlos Gomez: Good. We also need a soft-fail mode for high traffic: when ingestion lag > 3m we'll switch partner to batched 15m rollups automatically. Can Redwood trigger that?
Omar Ruiz: Yes. We can implement a dynamic feedback header in 429/200 responses instructing preferred frequency: X-Backoff-Until: timestamp. Partner must honor.
Liam Chen: Add a metric: partner_requested_freq vs actual_ingest_freq. We'll graph it per SKU.
Sophie Patel: Edge case: DST shifts for some regions. Partner device timestamps are local; must ensure we convert to UTC and treat ambiguous times using device timezone offset field.
Omar Ruiz: Agree. Require payload fields: timestamp (ISO8601), tz_offset or tz_name, device_id, usage_minutes, sku, signature, replay_id (optional), adjustment (optional), original_event_id (optional).
Emily Park: Can we get a sample payload to circulate?
Carlos Gomez: Sure, sending sample from partner QA (sanitized):
Carlos Gomez: ```
{
  "device_id": "acme-9876",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-29T01:30:00-04:00",
  "tz_name": "America/New_York",
  "usage_minutes": 5,
  "sku": "ACME-EDGE-XL",
  "signature": "sha256=abc123...",
  "replay_id": "replay-20250329-01"
}
```
Omar Ruiz: For signing, we will provide a shared secret and expect HMAC-SHA256 of body with header X-Acme-Signature. We'll return 401 for failures and log payload for debug (redact secrets).
Liam Chen: What about idempotency TTL? Keep seen-replay ids for 90 days. Also keep an event hash store for 7 days to dedupe real-time duplicates.
Sophie Patel: Partner wants assurance about billing alignment time. We'll offer: same-day billing if event arrives within 24h; otherwise falls into next billing period but flagged. Acceptable?
Emily Park: That's consistent. Document that in SLA + include small exceptions clause for mass outage.
Carlos Gomez: On reconciliation: we will provide daily ledger extract (CSV) by 09:00 UTC. Redwood will run recon and send a delta file.
Omar Ruiz: We'll implement tools/partner_daily_recon.sh that compares partner_ledger.csv vs ingested_events and outputs json with counts: matched, missing_on_partner, missing_on_redwood, adjusted_amounts.
Liam Chen: Add tolerance thresholds e.g., percent_missing < 0.2% for pass. If exceeded, open an investigation and pause auto-billing until resolved.
Sophie Patel: For the go-live cutover plan: 1) partner QA replay to staging (48h data) 2) ingestion smoke with 0 errors for 1h 3) production canary 1% -> monitor 30m 4) 10% -> monitor 30m 5) full enablement.
Emily Park: Communication plan: notify partner 24h prior; create dedicated Slack channel + Zoom. We will publish rollback criteria in channel pinned message.
Carlos Gomez: Partner will be on the Zoom and will send a dedicated ops contact.
Omar Ruiz: Rollback signals to pin: 1) 5xx >= 0.5% sustained 5m 2) ingest lag > 180s 3) daily recon missing rate > 1% 4) duplicate ratio > 3%. Any of these -> immediate rollback to batched 60m frequency and page SRE.
Liam Chen: We'll auto-run a reconciliation snapshot at 09:00 UTC for the first 7 days and notify ops if deltas > threshold.
Sophie Patel: Partner also requested a soft SLA credit policy: if our ingestion missed > 5% of events attributable to platform, offer pro-rated credit. Finance to finalize.
Emily Park: Noted. I'll loop in Finance and Legal after this thread.
metering-bot: staging-smoke: 2025-03-29T02:10Z - 3500 events ingested, 0 signature fails, avg latency 22s, duplicates 0.4%
Emily Park: Nice. Next steps: Omar + Liam to produce the tech playbook doc, Sophie + Carlos to finalize contract fields and mapping, I'll coordinate calendar + channel. I'll post the final checklist here once complete.
Carlos Gomez: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule partner-side dry run for Tue 02:00 UTC.
Emily Park: Closing the loop: please put the replay header and backoff header in contract. :thumbsup:
